title: Bag of bricks- Dark Green 23
descriptionHtml:
Dark Green — colour 23

A deep forest shade for the shadowed side of foliage. Layered underneath Green 22 and Grass 28, it's what stops a mass of greenery looking like a flat green rectangle.

Works well with: Green 22, Jungle Green 16, Olive Green 17

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Dark Green bricks (colour 23) for Memobrick mosaics. A deep forest shade for shadowed foliage and contrast against lighter greens.
